name: GL_SVSBF_USAGES
description: This table contains information about which business functions are enabled for enforcement of segment value security and the value set security mode for the enterprise.

columns.name: SVSBF_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Segment value security by business function usage identifier.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_SECURITY_MODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the chart of accounts segment value security mode that is applicable for the enterprise. Possible values are ORA_SVSBF for segment value security by business function and ORA_SDSVS for standard segment value security.

columns.name: AP_BUSINESS_FUNC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Payables business function is enabled for enforcement of segment value security. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: AR_BUSINESS_FUNC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Receivables business function is enabled for enforcement of segment value security. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: GL_BUSINESS_FUNC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the General Ledger business function is enabled for enforcement of segment value security. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: IC_BUSINESS_FUNC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Intercompany business function is enabled for enforcement of segment value security. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: FA_BUSINESS_FUNC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Fixed Assets business function is enabled for enforcement of segment value security. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: XLA_BUSINESS_FUNC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Subledger Accounting business function is enabled for enforcement of segment value security. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
